QuestInfo.name: The Dark Lord's Training
QuestInfo.0: The Dark Lord may think you're a normal Thief, but he seems to have the wrong idea about you...
QuestInfo.1:
The Dark Lord intends to fix your supposed laziness by making you train. Head to the Eastern Field of Kerning City and hunt #r40 Octopuses#k. Hey, a little extra training never hurt, right?



#o1120100# #r#a26111##k
QuestInfo.2: The Dark Lord was surprised when you reported in. Maybe he's starting to realize he had you wrong.

0.0: Usually, I direct new Thieves to aid the citizens of Kerning City, but you are too disgustingly lazy to be of any help. No, for YOU, I have some very special training...

yes.0: Exercise those useless muscles of yours by eliminating #b40#k #rOctopi#k. You can find them in droves at the construction site east of Kerning City. I doubt you'll complete the task, but if you do, let me know.

no.0: You can't refuse. If you do, I will banish you from Kerning City.

1.0: You actually returned, and you defeated the Octopi... So it's just your willpower that's lacking, not your skill.

yes.0: I'll trust you... for now. Prove yourself with this urgent matter that needs to be taken care of. Go out and meet the people of Kerning City and I'll call you in when the task is ready.

mob.0: I knew you didn't have it in you to defeat #r40 Octopi#k. Simply shameful.
